== New style pronouns and their proper use... ==

In this article, Lady Voldemort uses the phrase "an asha'man..bonded their wives." The new style of using "their" instead of "his" is meant to be used in situations where the actual gender of the person to which the pronoun refers may be indefinite.  For example, "each one got up to recite their story."  When the gender is known without a doubt, (as when we know the gender of a single asha'man) it is wholly appropriate to use "his." I actually changed the wording in the article, but changed it back when I remembered that I agreed in another discussion that typos were free game on these kinds of pages, but actual wording, no matter how incorrect, was sacrosanct.  So I'll grit my teeth when I read "their wives" and move on.
